summary: The hand-rolled redirect loop replays the original method and body on every hop, regressing the previous httpx follow_redirects semantics (303/302 POST -> GET)

Upstream used `follow_redirects=True`, where httpx converts POST to GET for 301/302/303 and drops the body (replaying only for 307/308). So a POST to a form that answers 302 - the standard login/upload pattern this tool is used for - now re-POSTs the same body to the redirect target: duplicated side effects and responses the model did not ask for (e.g. 405 from POST /dashboard), while the transcript still shows every hop.

summary: The new pause check in the partial-stall watchdog skips the withdrawal while paused but still counts the paused time, so the challenge is withdrawn on the first tick after the operator resumes.
detail: `_partial_stall_watchdog` compares `time.monotonic() - self._last_progress_monotonic > stall_seconds` (line 479) against a monotonic clock that keeps advancing during the pause; line 472's `continue` only defers the decision.
